extraction.Name: Peter Janis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 172 acre allotment, issued September 29, 1919; but was informed by the Pine Ridge Agency that it would be assessed for taxes, even if he did not take it, and later sold for taxes, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold for taxes by the County Treasurer of Fall River County, South Dakota
extraction.Buyer: Allen Barker, of Brennan, South Dakota, said he would pay the taxes and redeem the place
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes up to December 12, 1921; that it was sold for taxes by the County Treasurer of Fall River County, South Dakota
extraction.Occupation/Income: works at common labor for a living; that is his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health except he has eye trouble; has a wife whose health is not very good, she having eczema; has seven children to support, all of whom have good health except one who is ruptured; also owing store bills to Allen Barker of Brennan, South Dakota, and Levi W. Dodendorf of White Clay, Nebraska; deponent is still living on the allotment; Barker tells him that deponent is still the legal owner; deponent described as hazy in relating information; has never received any aid from the County, State, nor the United States Government; document dated December 3, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
